scope: 4D's Quick Report editor (QR REPORT with the editor), published by the native plugin alone from its form's layers: the toolbar, its Destination and Options panels, the report's sheet as a table of its row titles, its columns titled as their header buttons are drawn and each cell's drawn text, whose cells are pressed, written in place and open 4D's context menus with Show Menu, as do the column titles, with the pointer moved to each click; the record count; and the Fields sheet whose available fields are added by pressing and whose columns are selected and removed; a columnar report built, titled and formatted through accessibility and executed to HTML through macOS's Save dialog; the Fields sheet's available fields and report columns each a list element, the fields paging down and up with AXScrollDownByPage and AXScrollUpByPage; by AX and by VoiceOver
fixture: prepare_quick_report_fixture.py and test_quick_report_fixture.py (Orders table with five records and twenty note fields after its first five)
checks: the Quick Report editor is pixel-identical to the plugin-free editor
the toolbar's buttons are published by their titles
the record count is published, and a new report has no sheet
the Fields sheet publishes the available fields and the buttons that move them
the available fields and the report's columns are each one list, the fields showing their first lines
a page down shows the table's last fields
a page up shows its first fields again
pressing an available field adds it to the report's columns
a column pressed, then Remove column, leaves the report
OK returns to the editor, whose sheet is a table: a column per field, titled as 4D draws it, and the row titles first
writing a cell edits it in place: a column's title and its format
a column title's Show Menu opens 4D's menu for the column
a cell's Show Menu opens 4D's menu for the cell
the destinations are radio buttons, Print chosen
pressing HTML chooses it
Execute writes the report the sheet describes, with every record, the edited title and the format
VoiceOver reaches the Quick Report editor
VoiceOver reaches the Fields button
VoiceOver reads the available fields as one list
VoiceOver enters it and reads the available fields
VO-Space on a field adds it to the report's columns
VoiceOver reaches OK
OK makes the chosen field the report's column
VoiceOver reads the report's sheet as a table
interacting with it reads the first row's title
VO-Right reads the column's title cell
VoiceOver's actions menu offers the cell's Show menu
Show menu opens 4D's menu for the cell, which VoiceOver reads
VoiceOver reaches Destination
VoiceOver reads the destinations as radio buttons, Print selected
